findings.summary: Upstream repair (415 json_required on body-less POST) is already in place: httpClient.request sets Content-Type application/json and sends body {} for every POST/PUT/PATCH (httpClient.ts:90-101). archiveCompany/restoreCompany in companiesApi.ts needed no change; requireJsonWrites was left untouched. Confirmed by a probe running the shipped companiesApi + httpClient against the real createApp.

Capability-wide checks for CAP-dm-company (pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts, the 390 px/axe checks and the Play dev-link walkthrough) are integration evidence and were not run by this unit; the e2e spec belongs to another unit.

Server errorHandler sends field errors at error.fields; httpClient.readErrorDetails maps error.details first, then the extra keys, so form field errors from the server are exposed as details.fields. CompanyFormDialog relies on client validation for the same rules (name 2-80, required selects, CNPJ check digit).

evidence.command: npx vitest run --config <run-temp>/vitest.probe.config.ts (probe: create, edit, list ?q, archive, list archived, restore, delete 409 when active, archive + delete, get 404 through src/api/companiesApi.ts against server/app.ts createApp)

messages.text: CompanyPage exposes an onStartDiagnosis prop for the 'Começar o primeiro diagnóstico' / 'Novo diagnóstico' / 'Continuar diagnóstico' actions; it is not wired in src/App.tsx because starting a diagnosis is IF-003 (diagnosesApi). Wire it to diagnosesApi start + navigate to diagnostico/:diagnosisId.

The 'último resultado' link needs the latest completed diagnosis id, which IF-002 company payload does not carry (only latestStage/latestCompletedAt/draftId/completedCount). Add it to the company payload or resolve it via the history API.
Server validation errors arrive at error.fields; httpClient keeps them under ApiError.details.fields. If server field errors should show inline in CompanyFormDialog, map details.fields there.

Run the capability checks: pnpm test -- tests/unit/cnpj.test.ts tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts, then pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts, then the Play dev-link walkthrough (Empresas: create, edit, archive, restore, delete).
